mapper.select: SELECT su.user_id, su.avatar, bbr.number, p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_image, pl.level_name, bbr.created_at FROM blind_box_records bbr JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bbr.product_id JOIN shop_user su ON su.user_id = bbr.user_id JOIN product_level pl ON pl.level_id = p.product_levelid WHERE bbr.series_id = #{seriesId} AND bbr.box_number = #{boxNumber} ORDER BY bbr.created_at DESC

SELECT pb.box_id, pb.box_number, p.product_id, p.product_name, bpr.quantity, bpr.sold_quantity, p.product_image, p.product_price, pl.level_name, ps.price, CASE WHEN bpr.sold_quantity >= bpr.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_sold_out FROM product_box pb JOIN box_product_relation bpr ON pb.box_id = bpr.box_id JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bpr.product_id JOIN product_level pl ON p.product_levelid = pl.level_id JOIN product_series ps ON pb.series_id = ps.series_id WHERE pb.series_id = #{seriesId} AND pb.box_number = #{boxNumber} AND bpr.sold_quantity < bpr.quantity

SELECT pb.box_id, pb.box_number, p.product_id, p.product_name, bpr.quantity, bpr.sold_quantity, p.product_image, p.product_price, pl.level_name, ps.price, CASE WHEN bpr.sold_quantity >= bpr.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_sold_out FROM product_box pb JOIN box_product_relation bpr ON pb.box_id = bpr.box_id JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bpr.product_id JOIN product_level pl ON p.product_levelid = pl.level_id JOIN product_series ps ON pb.series_id = ps.series_id WHERE pb.series_id = #{seriesId} AND pb.box_number = #{boxNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blind_box_records (user_id, number, series_id, box_number, product_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{number}, #{seriesId}, #{boxNumber}, #{productId}, NOW())
